_readme: Release facts for /download (plan W16). The page reads every version string, filename,
size and digest from here, so nothing about a release is hard-coded in a component.
`version` is the version these ASSETS are. `latestTag` is the newest tagged
version, which the docs describe. When they differ the page says so, because a
download page that quietly serves an older build than the docs describe is the
one place that mismatch actually costs someone something.
v0.1.0 is published, so every `url` is a DIRECT link to an installer rather than the
Releases page — a Download button should hand you the file, not a page to hunt through.
Digests are real, measured from the published assets:
macOS and Linux were built locally; Windows is built on a windows-latest runner by
.github/workflows/release.yml in the app repo. `tested: false` means the installer
exists and nobody has run the app on that OS — it is not a claim that it is broken,
and not a claim that it works.
After a release: re-measure sizes and digests, and update `version`/`date` here.
Windows filename note: GitHub replaces spaces in asset names with dots, so
'TwinScope.Setup.0.1.0.exe'. Copy the name from the release, do not guess it.
